summary_en: Develops a matrix-free finite-element Bayesian uncertainty-quantification framework for realistic three-dimensional photoacoustic tomography. The method reformulates randomize-then-optimize sampling to generate independent posterior samples using only forward and adjoint wave propagations, carefully enforces discrete adjoint consistency, and validates posterior statistics on a general-domain problem with roughly 200,000 unknowns.

summary_en: Introduces RD-SCL for few-shot subsurface acoustic-impedance imaging. A differentiable first-order Tikhonov deconvolution operator estimates the latent seismic wavelet in the frequency domain, while symmetric cross-learning exploits labeled and unlabeled traces. The method is evaluated on SEAM and Marmousi 2 and is relevant to broad computational acoustic imaging, though outside the repository's central acoustic-optical and biomedical focus.
publication_note: Submitted to arXiv on 2026-07-23 and newly listed on 2026-07-24. Keep in candidates as core-adjacent because it is subsurface seismic acoustic imaging rather than acoustic-optical, sonar-camera, or biomedical imaging.
